svg.aria-label: Chase Sunstrom — software engineer and security consultant. I work close to the metal — C, C++, Rust and .NET — on compilers and build tools, bare-metal firmware, and the architecture of AI systems. Then I try to break it. Based in Urbandale, Iowa; currently consulting at Source Allies; open to consulting and contract work.
